title: StepTool: Enhancing Multi-Step Tool Usage in LLMs via Step-Grained Reinforcement Learning

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.1: 'a hybrid approach of rule-based heuristics and GPT-4 (gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09) to annotate step-grained rewards'; GPT-4 also judges pass rate following ToolBench.

prompt.note: The printed prompt is for reward annotation, not for a subject model.

data.source: StableToolBench / ToolBench I1-I3 and ToolLens test tasks

notes: Subject models are fine-tuned ToolLLaMA variants; the live model annotates rewards and evaluates pass rate.
